skill.name: data-cleaning-pipeline
skill.description: Guides AI assistants through profiling, deduplication, missing value handling, format standardization, and anomaly review for tabular datasets.
skill.summary: Turn messy datasets into cleaner, review-ready data workflows.
skill.author: Hermes-Sedimentary

content.value_statement: Messy datasets slow analysis and create unreliable results. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through practical cleaning steps.
actual_capabilities: Profiles messy datasets and identifies common quality issues.
Guides duplicate detection and removal decisions.
Suggests missing value handling based on column context.
Standardizes dates, categories, numbers, and text formats.
Highlights anomaly checks for review before analysis.
limitations: Requires the user to provide dataset context or samples.
Does not guarantee correct cleaning without human review.
Does not replace domain validation or statistical testing.
May need separate tooling for very large datasets.

use_cases.title: Prepare Analyst Spreadsheets
use_cases.description: Clean duplicated rows, inconsistent categories, and missing values before reporting.

use_cases.title: Standardize Client Imports
use_cases.description: Create repeatable cleaning steps for customer, sales, or operations data imports.

use_cases.title: Review Research Data
use_cases.description: Find formatting issues and outliers before modeling or sharing results.

prompt_templates.title: Profile a Dataset
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a small table or spreadsheet sample.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this dataset sample and list the main data quality issues. Group issues by duplicates, missing values, formats, and anomalies.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Cleaning Steps
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a practical workflow before editing data.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a cleaning plan for this dataset. Include the order of operations, fields to inspect, and checks I should run after each step.

prompt_templates.title: Normalize Field Values
prompt_templates.scenario: Standardize dates, categories, and numeric fields.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me standardize these columns. Explain the target format, ambiguous values, and validation checks for each field.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Cleaning Pipeline
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of an existing cleaning workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this data cleaning process for gaps. Identify risky assumptions, missing validation checks, and improvements for repeatable quality control.

output_examples.input: A customer list has duplicate emails, mixed phone formats, and blank company names.
output: Duplicate review based on email and normalized phone number.
Phone standardization into one regional format.
Missing company names flagged for manual enrichment.

output_examples.input: A sales export includes inconsistent dates, negative quantities, and repeated order IDs.
output: Date normalization plan with ambiguous entries separated.
Exception list for negative quantities and repeated order IDs.
Final validation checklist before revenue reporting.

best_practices: Keep an unchanged source copy before cleaning.
Document every transformation and review rule.
Validate cleaned data with counts, samples, and domain checks.
anti_patterns: Do not delete rows without recording the reason.
Do not fill missing values with one default for every column.
Do not treat statistical outliers as errors without context.

faq.question: What types of data can this skill help clean?
faq.answer: It is best for tabular data such as CSV files, spreadsheets, exports, and small database samples.

faq.question: Can it clean data automatically?
faq.answer: It can guide cleaning decisions and workflows, but users should review important changes before applying them.

faq.question: Does it write Python code?
faq.answer: It can help design steps that may be implemented in Python, but the skill itself is guidance-focused.

faq.question: How should I provide data?
faq.answer: Share a sample, column names, data definitions, and the analysis goal when possible.

faq.question: Can it detect anomalies?
faq.answer: It can suggest anomaly checks and review rules based on the fields and expected ranges.

faq.question: Is it suitable for sensitive data?
faq.answer: Use masked samples when possible, and avoid sharing private or regulated data unnecessarily.
